goal: Expose current activity, knowledge relationships, and decision lineage without replacing source-of-truth workflows.

sections.intent: Show observed agents and tasks flowing through Org Brain toward projects, with attention signals in context.
sections.layout: Three-zone desktop flow: observed agents, central Org Brain processing, project outcomes; event inspector and 24h timeline below.
sections.visual: Electric-blue data paths on near-black field; amber/red only for warning/critical branches.

sections.intent: Let users focus a knowledge object and understand its recorded neighborhood.
sections.layout: SVG relationship field with focus at center, one-hop inner ring, two-hop outer ring, project clusters, and sticky inspector.
sections.visual: Selected blue focus, white lessons, amber warnings, outlined project clusters; shape and labels duplicate color meaning.

sections.intent: Explain how current canonical knowledge emerged from decisions, learnings, assumptions, and sources.
sections.layout: Five horizontal lanes on desktop with time across x; vertical chronological feed on mobile; attention cards below.
sections.visual: Canonical blue lane, neutral supporting lanes, amber assumption/conflict lane, visible present-time marker.
must_avoid: classifying low confidence alone as assumption

responsive_strategy.desktop: Use wide visualization canvases with sticky inspectors and dense secondary metadata.
responsive_strategy.tablet: Stack visualization above inspector; collapse management navigation into a disclosure menu.
responsive_strategy.mobile: Use one-column cards, a vertical Strata timeline, horizontally scrollable bounded graph viewport plus list fallback, and 44px touch targets.
